wp-n.label: Chases used to fit the model (rest of IPL)
wp-n.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
wp-n.filters: Second innings reaching the eleventh over, result
wp-n.query: WITH p AS (SELECT d.innings_id, SUM(CASE WHEN d.over_num < 10 THEN d.total_runs ELSE 0 END) r10, SUM(CASE WHEN d.over_num < 10 AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) b10, MAX(CASE WHEN d.over_num >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) reached FROM deliveries d GROUP BY d.innings_id), w AS (SELECT d.innings_id, COUNT(*) w10 FROM dismissals x JOIN deliveries d ON d.delivery_id = x.delivery_id WHERE d.over_num < 10 GROUP BY d.innings_id) SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, i.batting_team_id bt, m.winner_id win, i.runs final, p.r10, p.b10, COALESCE(w.w10, 0) w10, i1.runs target1 FROM innings i JOIN p ON p.innings_id = i.innings_id LEFT JOIN w ON w.innings_id = i.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = i.match_id LEFT JOIN innings i1 ON i1.match_id = i.match_id AND i1.innings_number = 1 WHERE i.innings_number = 2 AND p.reached = 1 AND m.winner_id IS NOT NULL
